purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The state land registry/admin office is physically in Abeokuta and the official portal lists Abeokuta schemes. The official OLARMS-GIS landing page advertises parcel polygons and cadastral maps, but entry is through a sign-in/start flow and no public terms or anonymous schema are supplied. A separate property-ID map advertises parcel click-through to PID/address; it was not used. No anonymous geometry-only endpoint was verified.
registryAssessment: Ogun State’s official OLARMS portal describes state land registration/search and property-registration services, lists government land schemes in Abeokuta, and places the Bureau of Lands and Survey GIS office at Oke-Mosan, Abeokuta. This is city-located institutional evidence, not a claim of citywide parcel coverage.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Ogun State OLARMS page describes land allocation, property registration, title and land-search services; lists Abeokuta land schemes and the Bureau of Lands and Survey GIS office address in Abeokuta. Transaction applications require registration/payment.
OLARMS-GIS landing page advertises Ogun State parcel, zoning and cadastral map layers and links to a sign-in/start route; no public map schema or terms for anonymous retrieval were exposed.
Official Ogun State Property Registry search page advertises tapping building polygons to display a Property ID and sharing the ID/address. No position or parcel was searched or selected.
Official Ogun State portal describes its Physical Planning and Urban Development Ministry and statewide remit; no parcel feature service provided.
